text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clearer claim in the opening: 'I don't think that driverless cars are a good investment.'","quality":"clear thesis","description":"The essay states its position more directly and early, so the reader immediately knows the argument it will defend."},{"evidence":"multiple developed body paragraphs with distinct points about awareness, laziness, control, and accidents","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay supports its position with several separate reasons instead of relying on one main idea."},{"evidence":"counterargument paragraph beginning 'Some people would have to agree...'","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges the opposing view and responds to it, which makes the argument feel more balanced and persuasive."},{"evidence":"references to 'states' where driverless cars are illegal and worries about being 'to blame for accidents'","quality":"use of source-based support","description":"The essay connects its claims to details from the article rather than arguing only from personal opinion."},{"evidence":"concluding return to freedom and safety: 'Driving is a way to be your own person...'","quality":"conclusion effectiveness","description":"The ending restates the main position and leaves the reader with a clear final takeaway."}]}
